Agent Name: WebSurfer
Step Number: 1
Reason for Mistake: The WebSurfer agent encountered conflicting results about the birth year of Ferdinand I of Limburg Stirum, yet continued to rely on these without consolidating or verifying the information across multiple credible sources. Instead of refining its search strategy to target more authoritative records or resolved discrepancies, WebSurfer repeated similar searches, leading to ambiguity and lack of progress. This looping behavior is indicative of an error pattern where an agent fails to resolve conflicts and verify inconsistent data properly.
